title: Led the fraud check for the Amazon Pay India launch
summary: I conceived and led the one-account-per-customer fraud check for the Amazon Pay wallet launch in India, from requirements to onboarding, and built it for 1,150 TPS against a 20 TPS requirement.
what_would_have_happened: The wallet would have launched without a guard against one person opening many accounts to abuse offers.
the_call: Size the check for launch-promotion peaks and abuse traffic, well past the 20 TPS we were asked for.
what_i_did: Owned requirements, design, stakeholder communication, code reviews and onboarding for a four-engineer effort, and set up joint integration tests with the partner team.
what_changed: Launched on 14 Apr 2017 at 1,150 TPS; the end-to-end test suspended the fraudulent test accounts with the right reason codes, and the fraud and risk director thanked the team.

quotes.text: This is great work. Thanks team and looking forward to more deliveries for our payments business in India.
Great news !!!. Good job Team. Smooth integration is testimony on good design.
